name: B10-0050/2024 (PPE) – The deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the ‘Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice’
title: Resolution on the deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the “Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice”
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises the Taliban for a new law that further restricts women's lives in Afghanistan. The law orders women to cover their bodies and faces in public, travel only with a male relative, and not be heard in public. The Parliament asks the Taliban to end these abuses and restore women's access to education, work and public life. It also calls for accountability through the International Criminal Court and more EU sanctions.

- The Parliament condemns the Taliban's new law and calls for women's rights to be restored.
- It affects Afghan women and girls, who face further limits on public life.
- Next, the Parliament urges the international community to keep pressure on the Taliban.
